articles.title: PANORAMA: Panoptic Grounded Captioning via Mask Proposal Selection
articles.content: Intelligent systems that act in the world require image understanding that is both comprehensive and spatially grounded. Current vision-language models (VLMs) can generate fluent and detailed image captions, but reliably associating them with image pixels remains challenging. Existing methods that combine dense captioning with pixel-level grounding often produce either incomplete descriptions or inaccurate segmentation masks. We study this problem through panoptic grounded captioning, a task that requires a VLM to describe both foreground objects and background regions while grounding each referring phrase with pixel-level masks. We make three contributions. First, we introduce PanoCaps, a human-annotated benchmark constructed from panoptic segmentation datasets. It provides dense captions with near-complete pixel coverage and image-text alignments at the entity level, supporting both training and evaluation. We further propose a phrase-mask matching protocol and a generalized Panoptic Quality (gPQ) metric that jointly evaluates textual and mask agreement. Second, we formulate phrase grounding as selection from a phrase-conditioned pool of mask proposals and introduce PANORAMA, a VLM that conditions a pretrained segmenter on contextualized phrase representations to obtain candidate masks and learns to select those corresponding to each phrase. Training this interface jointly with caption generation enables PANORAMA to produce high-quality masks while allowing each phrase to refer to a single region or multiple instances. Third, PANORAMA achieves the best overall grounding on PanoCaps and matches or exceeds specialized models across several pixel-level grounding tasks. Experiments show that our method produces precise entity-level segmentations while maintaining detailed, mask-consistent captions. Code, data and models are available at https://www.di.ens.fr/willow/research/panorama/.

articles.title_zh: PANORAMA:通过遮罩提案选择泛光带地标
articles.content_zh: 在世界范围内运作的智能系统需要既全面又基于空间的图像理解。 当前的视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以产生流利而详细的图像标题,但可靠地将其与图像像素连接起来仍然是有挑战性的. 将密集字幕和像素级地平面相结合的现有方法往往产生不完整描述或不准确的分解口罩. 我们通过泛光学基础字幕来研究这个问题,这项任务需要一个VLM来描述前景对象和背景区域,同时将每个引用短语都用像素级口罩打出. 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,我们引入了PanoCaps, 由泛光分解数据集构建的人类附加说明的基准。 它提供密集字幕,在实体一级提供近乎完整的像素覆盖和图像文本对接,支持培训和评价。 我们进一步提出一个短语-mask匹配协议和一个通用的泛光学质量(gPQ)衡量标准,共同评价文字和遮罩协议. 第二,我们从一组带短语条件的口罩提案中将短语定位为选择,并引入了PANORAMA这一VLM,该VLM在语境化的口罩表述上以预先训练的分解器为条件,以获得候选口罩并学习选择与每个口罩对应的口罩. 与字幕生成共同培训此界面,使PANORAMA能够生产出高质量的口罩,同时允许每个短语指向一个单一区域或多个实例. 第三,PANORAMA在PanoCaps上实现最好的整体地基,在几个像素级地基任务中匹配或超过专门模型. 实验显示,我们的方法在保持详细、与口罩一致的标题的同时,产生精确的实体层面的分解。 代码、数据和模型见https://www.di.ens.fr/willow/research/panorama/。

articles.title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
articles.content: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.

articles.title_zh: 点Zero: 学习可转移的三维动态的三维点轨道补全
articles.content_zh: 具有预测场景如何在相互作用下演进的能力的世界模型内ow感知系统. 在接受不同数量数据的培训后,它们最有助于向下游应用注入丰富的数据。 现有方法一般要求机器人动作标签学习行动条件的3D动态,将网络视频数据排除在训练池之外. 我们研究3D点轨道的完成,作为学习没有机器人数据的可转移3D动力学的预训练目标. 鉴于一个单一的RGB-D观测和稀少的部分3D轨迹(轨迹),我们预测未来所有观测到的点的3D轨迹. 我们显示这个目标 产生丰富的3D动态之前, 不要求机器人动作标签。 我们提供了290万个合成帧的 不同的数据集 包括可变形的、清晰的和刚性的物体, 并用它来训练PointZero。 我们显示,一个灵活和表现式的变压器PointZero在同一个数据上比以前的方法要好。 我们通过训练后点Zero来证明我们的培训前目标对于两个下游应用的效用:(1) 行动条件的3D动态预测和(2) 模仿学习. 当微调到最终效果器的状态时,PointZero在近期的PGND 3D动态基准上超过了基线. 当微调预测机器人动作和3D轨道时,PointZero在6/7模拟和现实世界的机器人操纵任务上超越或匹配基线. 我们还从零开始评估培训点Zero,将我们拟议结构的好处与我们拟议培训前目标和数据集的好处分开。 我们发布了数据集,检查站, 和完整的培训食谱。

articles.title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
articles.content: Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies. The broad agentic capabilities of commercial vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-6 Astra, raise a compelling question: can these models learn from demonstrations, examples, and interaction feedback, then translate that information into executable and verifiable robot behavior from a new initial state without gradient updates or persistent changes to task-specific parameters? We introduce GPT-Policy, a general-agent framework for in-context robot learning. GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome. We evaluate its reliability and limitations through task success and efficiency metrics, matched comparisons across models, and controlled context ablations. In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks. These findings position GPT-Policy as a step toward robot adaptation through in-context learning, providing an empirical foundation for translating the general-purpose capabilities of VLMs into physical behavior and clarifying the challenges that must be overcome for reliable deployment.

articles.title_zh: 与 VLM 代理商一起学习 Context 机器人
articles.content_zh: 使机器人能够像人类一样随时适应陌生的环境,仍然是体现的AI的月光目标. 任何有限的示范集合都无法涵盖机器人将遇到的每一项任务和情况,因此,在部署时学习背景的能力对于普及至关重要。 然而,这种内在学习(ICL)在很大程度上仍然无法利用现有的机器人政策。 商业视觉语言模型(VLMs)的广义的代理能力,如GPT-6 Astra,提出了一个令人信服的问题:这些模型能否从演示,实例和交互反馈中学习,然后将这些信息从一个新的初始状态转化为可执行和可核查的机器人行为,而不对特定任务参数进行梯度更新或持续改变? 我们引入了GPT-Policy(GPT-Policy),这是内文机器人学习的一般代理框架. GPT-Policy集成了一个保存任务相关视觉过渡的上下文编译器,一个提出机器人工具动作的VLM,以及一个可验证和执行每个动作并报告其结果的受限控制器. 我们通过任务成功和效率衡量标准、各种模型的对比和可控背景分析来评估其可靠性和局限性。 在真机器人试验中,即使没有机器人动作标签,人类视频演示也改善了任务完成,而对齐的动作参考则在接触敏感任务上产生进一步收益. 这些结论认为,GPT政策是通过内文学习实现机器人适应的一个步骤,为将VLM的通用能力转化为物理行为提供了经验基础,并澄清了可靠部署必须克服的挑战。

articles.title: Adaptive Convolutional Sparse Coding via Information Bottleneck for Robust Visual Signal Representation
articles.content: Visual signals require compact yet sufficient representations for robust downstream prediction. Convolutional sparse coding (CSC) provides an explicit mechanism for suppressing redundant components while preserving signal content, but its sparsity coefficient is typically fixed and manually selected. We propose an adaptive convolutional sparse coding framework for robust visual signal representation. Specifically, we unfold the CSC optimization with the Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (FISTA) and treat the sparsity coefficient as a differentiable variable jointly learned with the network parameters. From the information bottleneck perspective, this coefficient controls the trade-off between information retention and compression: the sparsity term promotes compact representations, while the reconstruction term together with task loss preserves task-relevant signal content. We further introduce a label-free post-training strategy that adjusts the compression strength for corrupted inputs with the main network parameters fixed. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate competitive clean-data recognition and greatly improved robustness under different input perturbations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 适应性革命 通过 Information Bottleneck 为 Robust Visual Signal 显示系统进行编码
articles.content_zh: 视觉信号需要紧凑而充分的表示,以便进行强健的下游预测。 脉冲稀疏编码(CSC)为在保留信号内容的同时压制冗余组件提供了一种明确的机制,但其伸缩系数一般是固定和人工选择的. 我们提出一个适应性的零星编码框架,用于强大的视觉信号显示。 具体地说,我们用快速迭代缩水-阻力算法(FISTA)来展开CSC的优化,并将sparsity系数作为与网络参数共同学习的异变. 从信息瓶颈的角度来说,这个系数控制了信息保留和压缩之间的权衡:sparsity一词促进紧凑的表示,而重建术语与任务损失一起保留了与任务相关的信号内容. 我们进一步推行无标签的训练后策略,在固定主要网络参数的情况下,调整对腐败输入的压缩强度. 关于CIFAR和ImageNet的实验显示,在不同的输入扰动下,有竞争力地确认清洁数据,并大大提高了稳健性。

articles.title: Track, Articulate, Act: Generating Articulation from Casual Human Videos
articles.content: Human videos contain rich causal evidence for robot manipulation: they reveal how hand motion induces object motion and produces task-relevant changes in object state. In this work, we study articulated objects such as doors, drawers, cabinets, laptops, ovens, and hinged containers that are ubiquitous in daily life and present unique challenges for embodied interaction. These objects cannot be represented by a single pose; their motion depends on the underlying parts and joints. We introduce a real-to-sim framework that reconstructs a simulation-ready articulated object and hand-object interaction from a casual monocular RGB video, without RGB-D or multi-view input, prior scans, manually specified joints, or robot demonstrations. Our key insight is that dense 3D point tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic articulation cue: points on the fixed link remain approximately stationary, while points on the moving link follow coherent revolute or prismatic motion. Our method segments the links, estimates the joint and its state trajectory, reconstructs an articulated asset, and aligns the recovered 3D hand motion with the object. Central to our approach is a modular recipe that repurposes powerful pretrained models for single-image 3D reconstruction, mesh segmentation, and 3D scene flow, connecting their predictions through explicit geometric reasoning to infer articulation. We use the reconstructed articulated object and the human hand trajectory to replay interactions through contact in MuJoCo. The framework shows how pretrained vision models and explicit motion reasoning can turn casual human videos into articulated object models suitable for downstream embodied interactions. https://track-articulate-act.github.io/

articles.title_zh: 曲目、艺术、行为:从人肉录像中生成艺术
articles.content_zh: 人类视频中包含大量机器人操纵的因果证据:它们揭示了手动如何诱导物体运动,并在物体状态下产生与任务相关的变化. 在这项工作中,我们研究门、抽屉、柜子、膝上型计算机、烤箱和系链容器等明晰的物体,这些物品在日常生活中无处不在,对体现的互动构成独特的挑战。 这些物体不能用一个姿势来代表;它们的运动取决于基本部分和关节. 我们引入了一个真实到图像框架,从一个随机的单视的RGB视频中重建一个模拟准备的表达对象和手动对象交互,没有RGB-D或多视图输入,之前扫描,手动指定的关节,或机器人演示. 我们的关键见解是,密集的3D点轨道提供了一种表现-不可知的表达提示:固定链路上的点仍然大致固定不变,而移动链路上的点则遵循连贯的转动或棱镜运动。 我们的方法将链接分解,估计联合及其状态轨迹,重建一个清晰的资产,并使恢复的3D手动与对象相配合. 我们的方法的核心是一个模块化的食谱,它重新使用强大的预训模型,用于单像3D重建,网格分割,和3D场景流,通过明确的几何推理来连接他们的预测来推断表达. 我们利用重建的明亮物体和人手轨迹,通过在MujoCo的接触来重现相互作用。 该框架显示,经过预先训练的视觉模型和明确的运动推理能够如何将随机的人类视频转化为适合下游内含互动的清晰对象模型. https://track-articulate-act.github.io/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: MUSE: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Multi-Modal Understanding in Situated Education
articles.content: Large vision-language models have achieved remarkable progress in multi-modal understanding, yet their capabilities in educational settings remain insufficiently evaluated. In AI-assisted language learning, models must interpret artistic imagery, understand its semantic, affective, and cultural content, and reason about visual context to support meaningful interaction. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on real-world images or domain-specific educational reasoning, providing limited coverage of artistic educational content. To address this gap, we introduce MUSE, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models on artistic image understanding in situated educational applications. MUSE decouples image annotation from question generation, enabling diverse tasks with controllable difficulty while reducing annotation effort. It comprises twelve tasks spanning visual perception, semantic and affective interpretation, culture understanding, and compositional reasoning, together with diverse artistic images deliberately curated to center Singaporean and Southeast Asian multicultural contexts alongside Western art traditions, covering multiple themes and difficulty levels. Evaluation of open-source and proprietary models reveals substantial disparities across capability dimensions, particularly in affective interpretation and compositional reasoning. Our analysis further identifies common failure modes and key challenges for developing trustworthy multi-modal models for education. We hope MUSE will serve as a standardized benchmark for advancing multi-modal understanding in situated educational applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MUSE: 将大视野-语言模式作为在教学地点多模式理解的基准
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模式在多模式理解方面取得了显著进展,但它们在教育环境中的能力仍然没有得到充分的评价。 在AI辅助语言学习中,模型必须解释艺术图像,理解其语义性,情感性,以及文化内容,以及视觉背景的理由,以支持有意义的互动. 然而,现有的基准主要侧重于现实世界的图像或特定领域的教育推理,对艺术教育内容的覆盖面有限。 为解决这一差距,我们引入了MUSE这一基准,用于评价在定位教育应用中理解艺术形象的大型视觉语言模型。 MUSE从问题生成中解析图像注释,在减少注释工作的同时,使各种任务具有可控难度. 它包括12项任务,涉及视觉感知、语义和情感解释、文化理解和组成推理,以及各种艺术形象,这些艺术形象与西方艺术传统一道,被刻意用于新加坡和东南亚的多元文化中心背景,涵盖多个主题和困难程度。 对开源模型和专有模型的评价显示,在能力层面之间,特别是在情感解释和组成推理方面,存在着巨大差异。 我们的分析进一步确定了共同的失败模式和关键的挑战,以发展可信赖的多模式教育模式。 我们希望MUSE将成为在教育应用方面促进多模式理解的标准基准。

articles.title: PhysVGGT: Feed-Forward Dense Physical Property Estimation from A Single Image
articles.content: Physical properties, such as friction, hardness, stiffness, and density, govern how robots should grasp, manipulate and interact with objects, yet estimating these properties from RGB images remains challenging. Existing methods typically employ per-object reconstruction augmented with physical properties or directly query vision-language models at test time, which results in substantial computational overhead that limits their applicability. In this work, we present PhysVGGT, a feed-forward model that predicts dense maps of friction coefficient, Shore hardness, Young's modulus, and density, together with object-level mass, from a single RGB image in one forward pass. The key idea of PhysVGGT is to formulate physical property estimation as a dense per-pixel prediction problem and employ a visual geometry transformer to extract geometry-aware tokens from the input image followed by a dense prediction branch for estimating local physical properties and a global prediction branch for estimating object-level mass. In addition, we introduce a scalable pseudo-label generation pipeline that enables large-scale weakly supervised training for dense physical property prediction, substantially reducing the need for expensive direct physical measurements. Extensive experiments show that PhysVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ABO-500 dataset and generalizes effectively to the out-of-distribution NeRF2Physics dataset. Moreover, PhysVGGT eliminates the need for per-object reconstruction and test-time optimization, achieving an inference latency of only 0.13s per image, making it $27\times$ faster than the previous state of the art.

articles.title_zh: PhysVGGT: 种子前导 单项物质财产估计值 图像
articles.content_zh: 物理属性,如摩擦,硬度,僵硬度,密度,支配机器人如何把握,操纵和与物体互动,然而从RGB图像中估计这些属性仍然具有挑战性. 现有方法通常采用每个对象的重建,在试验时加上物理特性或直接查询视觉语言模型,从而造成大量的计算间接费用,限制了其适用性。 在这部作品中,我们提出了PhysVGGT,一种向导模型,它从一个向前传的单一RGB图像中预测摩擦系数的密集图,Shore硬度,Young的模度,以及密度,连同对象级质量. PhysVGGT的关键理念是将物理属性估计形成为每像素的密集预测问题,并使用视觉几何变压器从输入图像中提取几何感知符号,然后是用于估计局部物理属性的密集预测分支和用于估计物体级质量的全球预测分支. 此外,我们引入了可伸缩的伪标签生成管道,从而能够对密集的物理财产预测进行大规模弱监督培训,从而大大减少了对昂贵的直接物理测量的需求。 广泛的实验表明,PhysVGGT在ABO-500数据集上实现了最先进的性能,并有效地概括到分配外的NERF2物理数据集. 此外,PhysVGGT取消了对每个对象的重建和测试时间优化的需要,实现了每个图像只有0.13s的推论延迟,使其比之前的艺术水平快27\时元.

articles.title: NormLift: From Lifted Features To Semantic Reliability In 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Training-free weighted aggregation is widely used to lift 2D semantic features onto 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding, yet its theoretical role remains insufficiently understood. Existing analyses typically justify this operation from the rendering side, treating Gaussian features as linearly composable Euclidean variables for reconstructing 2D feature maps. However, this view does not match downstream 3D usage, where each Gaussian is often queried independently in a cosine-based embedding space. We revisit feature lifting from the 3D side and formulate per-Gaussian assignment as a cosine alignment problem on the CLIP unit sphere. Under this objective, the L2-normalized semantic back-projected feature emerges as the closed-form solution, providing a complementary interpretation of the standard lifting rule from the perspective of per-Gaussian semantic assignment. The same formulation further yields a norm decomposition into intra-view and inter-view consistency, suggesting that feature magnitude itself can serve as a semantic reliability signal. Calibrated by effective multi-view support, this reliability score guides a mode-voting refinement that preserves CLIP feature validity by avoiding linear averaging. Experiments on open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation show that NormLift is an efficient, training-free framework that achieves strong performance across evaluation protocols.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NormLift:从提升的特性到3D高斯白板中的语义可靠性
articles.content_zh: 无训练的加权聚合被广泛用于将2D语义特征提升到3D高斯人上,以进行开放式的-vocabulary场景理解,然而其理论作用仍未得到充分的理解. 现有分析通常从渲染侧面证明这一操作是合理的,将高斯特征作为线性可堆肥的欧几利得变量来重建2D特征地图. 然而,这种观点并不符合下游的3D用法,其中每个高斯人经常在一个基于余弦的嵌入空间中被独立询问. 我们重新审视从3D侧升起的特性,并将每加西方任务定为CLIP单位球体的余弦对齐问题。 在这个目标下,L2常态语义反投射的特征作为封闭式解决方案出现,从每个古西语语义任务的角度对标准提升规则提供了补充解释. 同样的提法进一步使规范分解为内观和内观的一致性,表明特征量本身可以作为语义可靠性信号. 通过有效的多视图支持校准,这种可靠性分数指导一种模式投票的完善,通过避免线性平均来保持CLIP特征有效性. 关于开放-vocabulary 3D语义分区的实验表明,NormLift是一个高效,无培训的框架,可以实现跨越评价协议的强效.

articles.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection
articles.content: When a large vision-language model misclassifies a harmful meme, the failure may reflect missing internal evidence or an inability to route represented evidence to its output. We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary tasks: Qwen averages $0.740$ versus $0.432$ native macro-F1, while residual reconstruction reaches $0.486$, whereas Gemma improves from $0.532$ to $0.714$. These differences reflect supervised accessibility rather than a pre-existing, native decision rule, and the most influential token role depends on the task. Under the evaluated score scales, Qwen silent-feature ablation is $24-63$ times more probe-sensitive, whereas routed-feature patching on literal yes/no tasks is $16-140$ times more output-sensitive. Calibration-only routing recovers $93.3$% of the mean gap, and probe-distilled LoRA improves native predictions, although shared multi-task adaptation causes negative transfer. A case study of Gemma-3-12B on Facebook Hateful Memes finds a distributed rank-32 image-prompt interaction, reaching $0.756$ versus $0.685$ native macro-F1. Robustness controls show that the signal extends beyond English, is not explained solely by accompanying OCR, and depends on paired visual evidence. Thus, routing, rather than representation alone, is a recurring bottleneck in harmful meme classification.

articles.title_zh: 可解码但路由错误: 破除视觉-语言模型中的读取差距,以发现有害的记忆
articles.content_zh: 当一个大型的视觉语言模型错误地将一个有害的meme分类时,失败可能反映缺失的内部证据或者无法将代表证据的路由到它的输出. 我们在Gemma-3和Quen3.5中用稀疏的自动编码器、角色限定探测器、因果干预和复原实验来区分这些病例, 在所有六个主要二进制任务上, Sparse 读出率超过本地预测: Quen平均为0.740美元,而本地宏观F1为0.432美元,剩余重建为0.486美元,Gemma则从0.532美元增至0.714美元。 这些差异反映了有监督的无障碍性,而不是一种原有的本地决策规则,最具影响力的象征性作用取决于任务. 根据评价的分数表,Quen的无声环境衰减是探测敏感度的24-63美元倍,而Lital yes/no任务上的路由环境补丁是产出敏感度的16-140美元倍。 只校准的路由回收了93.3%,平均差值的93.3 %,探测器蒸馏的LORA改进了本土预测,尽管共享的多任务适应会导致负转移. Facebook Hateful Memes上的Gemma-3-12B的案例研究发现分布式的排名为32的图像即时交互,达到0.756美元,而本地宏-F1. 强力控制显示信号延伸超过英语,不完全通过伴随OCR来解释,并且取决于配对的视觉证据. 因此,路由,而不仅仅是代表性,是有害的meme分类中反复出现的瓶颈.

articles.title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts
articles.content: Multimodal coding agents are expected to turn visual inputs into usable artifacts, and they act through a harness, the layer of tools, context management, and execution environment around the model. Existing evaluations often isolate short tool calls, API traces, or screenshot resemblance, and a low score under these proxies cannot say whether the model saw poorly, planned poorly, or was failed by its harness. We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source image must become an editable PowerPoint slide that preserves text, topology, layout, and native document structure. We introduce ReFigBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework built on 1,000 real overview figures retrieved from arXiv papers with full provenance. Coding agents from four model families reconstruct every figure under two workflows, direct code generation and a specialized PPTX workflow, and the strongest model runs inside two commercial harnesses, yielding ten configurations. Evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, repeated automated scoring by judges from two model families, and blinded human comparisons. Perception remains a bottleneck that iterative rendering only partly repays. Whether workflow effort converts into quality depends on the model together with its harness, since the same model gains from the specialized workflow inside one harness and loses inside the other, and the harness shifts scores even under an identical direct prompt. The specialized workflow erases native connectors in every configuration, human judges still prefer its renderings in most matchups, and even the strongest agent falls short of the rubric ceiling. These results expose the tension between fidelity and editability as the central challenge for practical multimodal document agents.

articles.title_zh: ReFig Bench: 将科学图重建作为可编辑的PowerPoint Artifacts的基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运编码代理商预计将将视觉输入转化为可用的文物,它们通过该模型周围的工具层、工具层、上下文管理和执行环境发挥作用。 现有的评价经常孤立短的工具呼叫,API痕迹,或截图相似,在这些代理下的低分分分不能说模型是看差,计划差,还是被其操纵失败. 我们研究科学的概观图重建, 这是一种代理任务, 源图像必须成为可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片, 我们介绍了ReFig Bench,这是一个基准和评价框架,其基础是从ArXiv文件中检索到的1 000个真实的概览数字和全部来源。 来自四个模型家庭的编码代理在两个工作流程下重建每个数字,直接代码生成和专用的PPTX工作流程,最强的模型运行在两个商业吊带内,产生十种配置. 评价结合了确定性文物检查,两个模范家庭的法官反复自动评分,以及盲目的人类比较. 认知仍然是迭代渲染只能部分回报的瓶颈. 工作流程是否转化为质量取决于模型及其利用,因为同一模型从一个利用内部的专门工作流程中得益,而另一个利用内部则失去,即使在同一直接的提示下,这种利用也会转移得分。 专门的工作流程在每一种配置中都抹去本土连接器,人类裁判员在大多数匹配中仍然更喜欢它的渲染,甚至最强的代理也未能达到面额天花板. 这些结果暴露了忠诚与可编辑性之间的紧张关系,这是对实用的多式联运文件代理人的核心挑战。

articles.title: Copy What Is Seen, Generate What Is Not: Training-Free Anomaly-Aware Video Restoration
articles.content: A surveillance system that detects an anomaly often has to repair the footage as well, yet the two tasks are studied in isolation: training-free anomaly detectors stop at a score or a label, while training-free video editing answers to a user prompt rather than to a detector. This paper proposes AVR (Anomaly-aware Video Restoration), which closes that gap with frozen pretrained models alone and generates content only where the clip offers no evidence to copy. Motion evidence first gates open-vocabulary proposals into spatio-temporal masks. A background prior computed from the clip then fills every pixel the anomaly ever uncovers, leaving diffusion to synthesize only what no frame showed, and a frozen verifier decides per clip whether to trust a classical, a prior-anchored, or a background-conditioned restorer. Extensive experiments on three surveillance datasets, under both full-reference anomaly injection and real anomalies, show that AVR leads full-frame fidelity under oracle masks, matches three trained video inpainters inside the edited region, and outperforms a detect-then-generate pipeline on the masks it produces itself, while suppressing both the residual anomaly and the flicker of free diffusion.

articles.title_zh: 复制所见所闻, 生成所不见的 : 无训练异常- 智能视频修复
articles.content_zh: 发现异常的监视系统往往也得修复镜头,然而这两项任务都是孤立地研究的:无训练异常探测器停留在分数或标签上,无训练视频编辑则回答用户的即时而不是探测器. 本文提出AVR(Anomaly-aware Video Recovery),它仅用冷冻的预先训练过的模型来弥补这一缺口,只有在剪辑无法提供复制证据的情况下才会产生内容. 动议证据首先将公开-vobulary建议输入spatio-timperal口罩. 从剪辑中计算出来的前一个背景,然后填充所有发现的异常的像素,只让扩散合成没有显示的帧,由冷冻的核查者决定每个剪辑是相信古典的,前置的,还是背景条件的恢复器. 在全面参考异常注射和真实异常下对三个监控数据集进行的广泛实验表明,AVR在甲骨文口罩下引领全帧忠贞,在编辑区域内匹配三个训练有素的视频印像仪,并在它自己生产的口罩上超越一个检测-当时遗传的管道,同时抑制残余异常和自由扩散的闪烁.

articles.title: Using OCR Heads to Verbalize Image Semantics
articles.content: How do VLMs map from pixels to semantics? To understand this general question, we focus on a narrow one: studying how VLMs perform optical character recognition (OCR). Across four models, we identify attention heads causally necessary for OCR, and discover that these are in fact general-purpose heads that output interpretable semantic features across all image tokens. For example, pointing these heads at an image token containing the word "bike" causes Qwen3-VL-8B to output "bike," but pointing them at a bird wing causes the model to output the token "feathers." We collapse these heads' attention weights into a single verbalization lens transformation that reveals interpretable semantic features in hidden states across all layers. When combined with projection to vocabulary space, we can obtain interpretable labels starting from layer 0, showing that image representations are in fact aligned with language in early layers. We find that we can also use the inverse of this transformation to edit non-word concepts, e.g., replacing a tractor with a revolver in a naturalistic image, providing causal evidence that this subspace is useful for more than just OCR. Our results are an example of how the study of specific mechanisms can shed light on broader interpretability problems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用 OCR 头来修改图像语义
articles.content_zh: VLMs 如何从像素映射到语义? 为了理解这个一般性的问题,我们侧重于一个狭义的问题:研究VLMs如何进行光学字符识别(OCR). 在四种模型中,我们确定OCR因果需要的注意头,发现这些实际上是通用头,在所有图像符号上输出可解释的语义特征. 例如,将这些头指向一个包含"自行车"字样的图像符号,导致Qune3-VL-8B输出"自行车",但将头指向鸟翼则导致模型输出符号"feathers". 我们把这些头部的注意力重量 分解成一个单一的语音透镜转换 揭示出所有层次的 隐藏状态中可解释的语义特征 当与投影到词汇空间相结合时,我们可以从第0层开始获得可解释的标签,显示图像表达方式实际上与早期层的语言一致. 我们发现,我们也可以利用这种变换的反面来编辑非词性概念,例如用自然主义形象的左轮手枪取代牵引力,提供因果关系证明这个子空间不仅对OCR有用. 我们的成果是研究具体机制如何能够阐明更广泛的可解释性问题的一个例子。

articles.title: DISTA-Net++: Rethinking Infrared Small Target Unmixing Beyond Sub-Pixel Separation
articles.content: Long-range infrared imaging frequently confronts dense target clusters whose diffraction-limited signatures merge into a single indistinguishable blob, concealing the number, sub-pixel positions, and radiant intensities of the underlying sources. While deep learning has advanced general object detection, resolving such Closely-Spaced Infrared Small Targets (CSIST) remains largely unexplored, owing to a systemic infrastructure void and a fundamental paradigm mismatch. The dominant formulation, which reduces unmixing to a blind, discrete sub-pixel separation, is inherently insufficient: without semantic guidance, the ill-posed inverse problem admits ambiguous solutions plagued by false and missed detections, while grid-based discretization locks predictions onto fixed lattice centers, chaining precision to prohibitively expensive grid refinement. We argue that CSIST unmixing should instead be informed and continuous. To ground this paradigm shift, we establish the first comprehensive open-source ecosystem for the field, comprising the large-scale CSIST-100K benchmark, a tailored metric suite, and the GrokCSO toolkit. Upon this foundation, we propose DISTA-Net++, which anchors a dynamic deep unfolding backbone with two synergistic mechanisms: a Count-Guided Prior that injects the global target count as an explicit semantic constraint to regularize the solution space, and a Continuous Coordinate Rectification that regresses off-grid offsets to decouple localization accuracy from grid resolution. Extensive experiments validate our paradigm: even under the most economical 3x division, DISTA-Net++ surpasses 7x-division state-of-the-art methods by 16.15% in CSO-mAP and 62.96% in count accuracy at merely one-sixth of their computation, demonstrating that unmixing precision need not be purchased with finer discretization. The complete ecosystem is available at https://github.com/GrokCV/GrokDet.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DITA-Net++: 重新思考红外小目标在子像素分离之外的未混合
articles.content_zh: 长程红外成像经常遇到密集的目标集群,其分散性有限签名合并成一个无法分辨的斑点,隐藏了数量,子像素位置,以及基础来源的光亮强度. 虽然深入学习已推进了一般物体探测,但解决这种近空红外小目标(CSIST)的工作基本上仍未进行探索,原因是系统基础设施空白和根本的范式不匹配。 主流配方将不混为一目,离散的子像素分离减少,其内在不足:没有语义指导,不良的反向问题就承认了被虚假和错失的检测所困扰的模棱两可的解决方案,而基于网格的盘片化锁将预测锁在固定的网格中心上,将精度连锁到极其昂贵的网格完善上. 我们主张,应不断通报CSIST的解密情况。 为了实现这一范式转变,我们为实地建立了第一个全面的开放源生态系统,包括大规模CSIST-100K基准、定制的成套指标和GrokCSO工具包。 基于这一基础,我们提议DITA-Net++,它用两个协同机制,即 " 伯爵指导 " ,支撑一个动态的深层骨干。 在此之前,注入全球目标计数是使溶液空间规范化的一个明确的语义约束,而连续的坐标校正则将离网抵消,从而将本地化精度与网格分辨率脱钩。 广泛实验验证了我们的范式:即使在最经济的3x分法下,DITA-Net++在CSO-mAP中比7x分法的先进度高出16.15%,在计数精确度上仅比其计算值的六分之一高出62.96%,这表明不混合精度不需要用更精细的光碟化来购买. 完整的生态系统可在https://github.com/GrokCV/GrokDet上查阅。

articles.title: Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Recognition of Sign Language Handshapes
articles.content: Sign language processing advances rapidly for high-resource languages such as American Sign Language (ASL), yet most of the world's sign languages lack the phonological annotations new methods require. We present the first zero-shot cross-lingual framework for handshape recognition, transferring from ASL to Catalan Sign Language (LSC). Our approach leverages the decomposition of handshapes into five phonological features -- selected fingers, flexion, spread, thumb position, and thumb contact -- shared across both languages, to decode LSC handshapes from predicted features via a composite phonological distance metric. We evaluate three architectures (MLP, SL-GCN, SHuBERT) trained on two ASL corpora (PopSign, Sem-Lex) against a 37-handshape, single-signer LSC benchmark. Zero-shot transfer proves viable once recording-format disparities are harmonized, reaching 80.0% phonological feature accuracy and 54.5% expected handshape accuracy. Phonological decomposition thus offers a bridge for extending sign language technologies to low-resource languages without any target-language video training labels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 零光线交叉 手语手巾的识别
articles.content_zh: 对美国手语(ASL)等高资源语言而言,手语处理迅速推进,然而世界上大多数手语都缺乏新的音素说明方法. 我们提出第一个用于手巾识别的零镜头跨语言框架,从ASL转移到加泰罗尼亚手语(LSC). 我们的方法利用手风琴的分解作用,将手风琴分解为五个音响特征 -- -- 选定的手指、弹性、伸展、拇指位置和拇指接触 -- -- 这两种语言都共享,通过复合音响距离测量法,将LSC手风琴从预测特征中解码。 我们评价三种架构(MLP,SL-GCN,SHuBERT),对两个ASL corpora(PopSign,Sem-Lex)进行训练,对照一个37手形,单签名的LSC基准. 一旦记录格式差异得到统一,零镜头传输证明是可行的,达到80.0%的唱片特征精度和54.5%的预期手拍精度。 因此,唱片分解为将手语技术推广到没有目标语言视频培训标签的低资源语言提供了桥梁。

articles.title: Toward Markerless Video-based Tremor Analysis: Objective Quantification of Pathological Tremor in Mouse Preclinical Models
articles.content: Tremor is a movement disorder characterized by involuntary, rhythmic oscillations of body parts and is a hallmark of several neurological conditions, including Parkinson's disease and essential tremor. Elucidating its underlying mechanisms relies heavily on mouse models, which offer genetic manipulability and translational relevance to human neural circuitry. Accordingly, these models are indispensable for studying tremor pathophysiology. So far, electromyography and accelerometers have been used as methods to quantitatively observe tremors in mice. However, these methods have several drawbacks, such as high costs and complex setups. In particular, the invasive surgical implantation of devices causes significant stress to the animals. Although RGB-based methods offer non-invasive and cost-effective alternatives, they often lack the sensitivity required to detect subtle tremors. Therefore, this paper addresses these challenges by achieving mouse tremor severity estimation using conventional RGB cameras only. To address the challenging task of isolating tremor-related vibrations while the mouse itself is also in motion, our pipeline incorporates segmentation-based pre-processing to extract the mouse region and a Tremor Score Estimation Module that captures subtle tremors with high sensitivity. In the experiments, we assessed tremors in unrestrained mice using a non-invasive method with two standard cameras. The results demonstrated a strong correlation with accelerometer measurements and confirmed that the method accurately captured the intensity-dependent characteristics of tremors. The project page is available at https://isogawalab.github.io/Video-based-Tremor-Analysis-Project/.

articles.title_zh: 走向无标记视频透视分析:鼠标临床前模型病理透视的客观量化
articles.content_zh: Tremor是一种运动障碍,其特征是身体部位的非自愿,节奏振荡,是包括帕金森病和基本颤抖在内的几种神经病症的特征. 减轻其基础机制严重依赖鼠标模型,这些模型提供了基因操纵性和对人类神经电路的翻译相关性. 因此,这些模型对于研究颤抖病理学是不可或缺的。 迄今为止,电传记仪和加速计被用作在小鼠中定量观测颤动的方法. 然而,这些方法有一些缺点,例如费用高昂和设置复杂。 特别是设备的入侵性外科植入给动物造成了很大压力。 虽然基于RGB的方法提供了非侵入性和成本效益高的替代品,但它们往往缺乏检测微妙颤抖所需的敏感性. 因此,本文件仅通过使用常规RGB相机实现鼠标颤抖严重性估计来应对这些挑战。 为了应对在鼠标本身也在运行时隔离颤抖相关振动这一艰巨任务,我们的管道采用了分解预处理方法,以提取鼠标区域,并采用了Tremor计分估计模块,以高敏感性捕捉微妙颤抖。 在实验中,我们用两台标准照相机使用非侵入方法评估了无限制小鼠的颤抖. 结果显示了与加速计测量的强烈相关性,并证实该方法准确地捕捉了颤抖的强度依赖特征. 项目网页见https://isogawalab.github.io/Video-based-Tremor-Analysis-Project/。

articles.title: Geometry beneath the Waves: Dense Priors for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Underwater 3D reconstruction supports applications ranging from marine ecosystem monitoring and subsea inspection to underwater archaeology, education, and immersive visualisation. 3D Gaussian Splatting has made real-time photorealistic novel-view rendering practical, while underwater variants incorporate physically based image-formation models to separate medium effects from scene radiance. Their reconstruction quality, however, remains fundamentally limited by the geometry used for initialisation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 海浪下几何: 斯帕塞-维尤水下三维高斯电镀的深层前题
articles.content_zh: 水下3D重建支持各种应用,从海洋生态系统监测和海底检查到水下考古、教育和浸透视觉。 3D Gaussian Splating使实时的光现实主义小说-视觉渲染实用,而水下变体则结合了基于物理的图像-造型模型,将中等效果与场景光分离开来. 然而,它们的重建质量仍然受到用于初始化的几何学的根本限制.

articles.title: Mask IPL: Noise-Free Intrinsic Position Learning via Computation Graph Clipping for Event-Based Spike-Driven Tracking
articles.content: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) match the event-driven nature of event cameras and naturally extract spatiotemporal features. These properties have motivated a series of recent studies on event-based tracking with SNNs. Intrinsic Position Learning (IPL) acquires strong position information without introducing additional parameters, making it a mainstream approach for position encoding in event-based spike-driven tracking. However, the mechanism behind its effectiveness lacks systematic theoretical analysis. Moreover, our analysis reveals that IPL introduces noise in both forward and backward propagation. The former increases inference error, while the latter prevents parameters from converging to better solutions. This paper presents a systematic analysis of IPL and demonstrates that its effectiveness stems from the synergy between IPL and multi-stage convolution. The zero blocks in the joint tensor act as zero padding for convolution, and the resulting boundary effect propagates layer by layer through multi-stage convolution. Every parameter update is therefore driven by a gradient that perceives the relative displacement between template and search frames. Positional encoding added after the convolutional stage cannot provide this information. We further propose a simple Computation Graph Clipping method that applies a validity mask determined by the layout to the operations of every layer, making invalid regions equivalent to zero padding in both forward and backward propagation. This eliminates the noise without introducing additional parameters and makes the actual gradient coincide with the ideal gradient. We name the improved method Mask IPL. Without increasing parameters or computational cost, Mask IPL improves the AUC of the Tiny-scale tracker on FE108, FELT, and VisEvent, and consistently improves the Base-scale tracker as well.

articles.title_zh: Mask IPL: 通过计算图形剪辑用于基于事件的Spike-Driven跟踪的无噪声内置位置学习
articles.content_zh: Spiking神经网络(SNNs)匹配事件摄像头的事件驱动性质,并自然提取spatiopal特征. 这些属性激发了最近一系列与SNNs基于事件追踪的研究. 内定位置学习(IPL)在不引入额外参数的情况下获取强位信息,使其成为基于事件突起驱动跟踪中定位编码的主流方法. 然而,其效力背后的机制缺乏系统的理论分析。 此外,我们的分析表明,IPL在前向和后向传播中都引入噪音。 前者增加了推论错误,而后者则阻止参数趋同到更好的解决方案. 本文件对杀伤人员地雷进行了系统分析,并表明其有效性源于杀伤人员地雷与多阶段演变之间的协同作用。 连锁拉力中的零块作用为折射的零垫板,由此产生的边界效应通过多阶段折射逐层传播. 因此,每个参数更新都由一个梯度驱动,该梯度可以感知模板和搜索框架之间的相对位置。 在演化阶段后添加的位置编码不能提供这种信息. 我们进一步提出一个简单的计算图形剪切方法,将一个由布局决定的有效性掩码应用于每层的操作,使无效区域相当于前向和后向传播中的零固定. 这消除了噪音而未引入额外的参数,使实际梯度与理想梯度吻合. 我们命名改进的方法 面具IPL。 在不增加参数或计算成本的情况下,Mask IPL改进了FE108、FELT和VisEvent上的小型跟踪器的AUC,并持续改进了Base级跟踪器。

articles.title: RankGround: Efficient High-Resolution GUI Grounding via Lightweight Reranker-Guided Crop Selection
articles.content:
Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is a fundamental perception task for multimodal agents, enabling them to interpret natural language instructions and interact with digital interfaces. Existing methods face a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and efficiency: direct full-image inference often fails to capture small or visually similar UI elements, while multi-crop strategies improve localization at the cost of multiple expensive Vision-Language Model (VLM) calls per query.
  To address this challenge, we propose RankGround, a two-stage framework that achieves accurate GUI grounding with a single VLM call per query. Central to our approach is GroundRanker, a lightweight multimodal reranker that identifies the most promising crop from a dense candidate set. Because no off-the-shelf ranking dataset is available, we construct ranking supervision data from existing grounding datasets. A strict containment criterion and boundary-aware positive augmentation improve alignment and spatial coverage in cluttered layouts. GroundRanker is then trained with a two-stage curriculum: a pointwise objective first learns coarse containment, and a listwise objective refines subtle semantic and spatial distinctions among visually similar crops.
  Experimental results show that RankGround consistently outperforms strong baselines while reducing computational cost. It achieves 1.4 times faster inference and improves localization accuracy by 5.5% on average over the second-best method across all backbones and screen scales, establishing a new state of the art in both efficiency and precision for GUI grounding.

articles.title_zh: RankGround: 通过轻量级 Ranker- Guided 作物选择实现高效的高分辨率 GUI 定位
articles.content_zh:
图形用户界面(GUI)定位是多模式代理的一项基本感知任务,使他们能够解释自然语言指令并与数字界面互动. 现有方法面临精度和效率之间的根本权衡:直接的全图像推论往往无法捕捉到小的或视觉上相似的UI元素,而多作物策略则以多次昂贵的Visual-Langage Model(VLM)每次查询调用为代价,改善本地化.
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议RankGround,一个两阶段框架,通过每个查询一个VLM呼叫,实现准确的图形用户界面定位。 我们方法的核心是地面车手(GroundRanker),这是一种轻量级的多模式调整车型,它从密集的候选作物中找出最有前途的作物。 由于没有现成的排名数据集,我们从现有的地面数据集构建排名监督数据. 严格的封闭标准和有边界意识的正增强作用可改善布局的一致和空间覆盖。 然后,GroundRanker通过两个阶段的课程培训:一个是分明的目标,首先学习粗糙的封装,另一个是按清单的目标,完善视觉相似作物之间的微妙语义和空间区别。
实验结果显示,RankGround在降低计算成本的同时,一贯超越强基线。 它实现了1.4倍的更快推论,并且在所有主干线和屏幕尺度的第二最佳方法上,平均提高了5.5%的本地化精度,为GUI定位建立了效率和精度的新水平。

articles.title: Generalist-Specialist Mixture-of-Experts for Rare Pathology Detection in Multimodal Imaging
articles.content: AI models for multimodal medical imaging must balance modality-specific specialization with cross-modal shared representations, a trade-off that pure Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures currently fail to satisfy. Expert-based routing improves in-domain learning but may sacrifice cross-modal signals, which appear particularly important for rare (low-prevalence) pathologies in our experiments. To resolve this, we introduce Generalist-Specialist-MoE (GS-MoE), a two-branch (MoE) architecture that couples a cross-modal generalist model with distinct modality-specific specialists (experts) via domain-constrained feature fusion. On RadImageNet (1.35M images, 165 pathologies, three modalities), GS-MoE recovers detection of six low-prevalence pathologies on which every baseline scores F1 $=$ 0, with per-class gains up to +0.60 F1. It attains this while even slightly exceeding dense and specialist-only MoE aggregate baselines (MCC 0.770), while using ${\sim}53\%$ fewer active parameters at inference than the strongest investigated dense model.

articles.title_zh: 稀有病理学多式成像检测专家一般专家
articles.content_zh: 人工智能的多式联运医学成像模型必须平衡模式特有的专业化与跨模式共享的表示,这种权衡是目前纯粹的专家混合结构无法满足的。 基于专家的路由可以改善国内学习,但可能牺牲跨模式信号,这对我们实验中罕见的(低流行率的)病理学来说显得特别重要。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了通用-专门-MoE(GS-MoE),一种双分支(MoE)架构,通过域内限制的特征聚变,与具有不同模式的特异性专家(专家)的跨模式通用主义模式结合。 在RadImageNet上(1.35M图像,165个病理,三种模式),GS-MOE恢复了对6种低流行率病理的检测,根据这些病理,每个基线得分F1美元=0美元,每类收益最高为+0.60 F1. 它在达到这一目的的同时,甚至略微超过密度和专门化的教育部总基线(MCC 0.770),而使用有效参数推算比最强的调查密度模型少53美元。

articles.title: Video-Based Markerless Motion Capture for Clinical and Rehabilitation Biomechanics: A PRISMA-ScR Scoping Review of Validated Architectures, Clinical Readiness, and Emerging Methods
articles.content: Background.. Video-based markerless motion capture promises movement analysis without the cost, space and skin-marker constraints of optoelectronic systems, with particular potential for clinical and rehabilitation settings. Whether validated pipelines yet deliver clinically acceptable biomechanics, and how they relate to the underlying computer-vision research, remains unclear. Methods. We conducted a scoping review following the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews, with a registered protocol and searches of PubMed, Scopus and IEEE Xplore (January 2015 to February 2026; the computer-vision scan was updated to July 2026). A dual-tier design paired a primary corpus of validated biomechanical studies with a complementary, curated and deliberately non-exhaustive corpus of emerging computer-vision work, used qualitatively. We charted study characteristics, pipeline architecture, validation methods and joint-angle accuracy. Results. We included 117 studies, most published from 2024 onward and conducted on healthy adults walking in a laboratory. Pipelines formed five architectural families across monocular and multi-camera modalities; most reported raw joint angles without biomechanical refinement. Sagittal lower-limb agreement clustered around 5 to 6{\textdegree}, generally short of clinical acceptability, while out-of-plane kinematics, kinetics, and pathological or older populations were rarely validated. Emerging computer-vision building blocks (foundation-model mesh recovery, differentiable inverse kinematics, video-based kinetics) were almost absent from validated studies. Conclusions. Video-based markerless capture is not yet interchangeable with marker-based systems for clinical joint kinematics, and it remains barely validated where rehabilitation needs it most: older and pathological populations, out-of-plane kinematics, and kinetics. Mapping this evidence gap onto emerging computer-vision advances, we propose hypothesis-generating design guidelines, not a validated method, to steer the next generation of pipelines toward accessible, clinically meaningful movement analysis.

articles.title_zh: 用于临床和康复的无标志运动捕捉生物力学:对经过验证的建筑、临床准备状态和新兴方法的PRISMA-ScR范围审查
articles.content_zh: 背景情况。 基于视频的无标记运动捕捉承诺在没有光电子系统的成本、空间和皮肤标记限制的情况下进行运动分析,尤其有可能进行临床和康复环境分析。 验证过的管道是否提供了临床上可接受的生物力学,以及这些管道与基本的计算机视觉研究有何关系,仍然不清楚。 方法。 办法。 我们在PRISMA扩展范围审查范围之后进行了一次范围审查,对PubMed、Scopus和IEEE Xplore进行了注册协议和搜索(2015年1月至2026年2月;计算机-视觉扫描更新至2026年7月)。 双层设计将经验证的生物力学研究初级体与质量上使用的计算机视觉工作配套的、经过整理的和有意的、并非详尽无遗的生物力学研究体相配对。 我们绘制了研究特征、管道结构、验证方法和联合角精确度图。 结果。 我们包括117项研究,大多数是从2024年以后出版的,并且是在实验室里行走的健康成年人。 管道跨越单相机和多相机模式组成了五个建筑家族;大多数报道的原始关节角没有生物机械改进. 浅层低层协议聚集在5到6⁄Textform}左右,一般缺乏临床的可接受性,而飞机外动能,动力学,病理学或老年人群则很少被验证. 正在形成的计算机-视觉构件(创始-模型网状恢复、不同的反动能、基于视频的动力学)几乎没有经过经过验证的研究。 结论。 基于视频的无标记捕捉尚不能与基于标记的临床联合动能系统互换,在康复最需要的地方,即老化和病理人群、飞机外动能和动能,仍然几乎无法验证。 将这种证据差距描绘在新兴的计算机-视觉进步上,我们提出假想生成设计准则,而不是一种经过验证的方法,引导下一代管道向可获取的,临床上有意义的运动分析方向发展。

articles.title: GenStream: Semantic Streaming Framework for Generative Reconstruction of Human-centric Media
articles.content: Video streaming dominates global internet traffic, yet conventional pipelines remain inefficient for structured, human-centric content such as sports, performance, or interactive media. Standard codecs re-encode entire frames, foreground and background alike, treating all pixels uniformly and ignoring the semantic structure of the scene. This leads to significant bandwidth waste, particularly in scenarios where backgrounds are static and motion is constrained to a few salient actors. We introduce GenStream, a semantic streaming framework that replaces dense video frames with compact, structured metadata. Instead of transmitting pixels, GenStream encodes each scene as a combination of skeletal keypoints, camera viewpoint parameters, and a static 3D background model. These elements are transmitted to the client, where a generative model reconstructs photorealistic human figures and composites them into the 3D scene from the original viewpoint. This paradigm enables extreme compression, achieving over 99.9% bandwidth reduction compared to HEVC for the continuous data stream. We partially validate GenStream on Olympic figure skating footage and demonstrate potential for high perceptual fidelity under minimal data. While acknowledging the significant computational costs shifted to the client and challenges in generalization, GenStream opens new directions in volumetric avatar synthesis, canonical 3D actor fusion across views, and personalized viewing experiences, laying the groundwork for scalable, intelligent streaming in the post-codec era.

articles.title_zh: GenStream:以人类为中心的媒体的基因重建语义流派框架
articles.content_zh: 视频流传在全球互联网流量中占据主导地位,然而传统管道对于结构化、以人为本的内容,如体育、表演或互动媒体,仍然效率低下。 标准解码器重新编码整个帧,前景和背景都一样,统一处理所有像素,忽略了场景的语义结构. 这导致带宽浪费,特别是在背景静止、运动受少数突出行为者制约的情况下。 我们引入了GenStream,一个语义流线框架,用紧凑,结构化的元数据来取代密集的视频帧. GenStream不是发送像素,而是将每个场景编码为骨骼键点,镜头视角参数,以及静态3D背景模型的组合. 这些元素被传递给客户端,一个基因模型重建了光现实主义的人类人物,并从最初的角度把它们合成到3D场景中. 这个范式可以实现极端压缩,与HEVC相比,连续数据流的带宽减少超过99.9%. 我们部分验证了奥运人物滑冰镜头上的GenStream,并展示了在最低数据下具有高度感知忠诚的潜力。 GenStream在承认重大的计算成本转移到客户端以及泛化方面的挑战的同时,开启了卷曲动漫合成的新方向, canonic 3D演员跨观点融合,以及个性化的观看体验,为后编码时代的可伸缩,智能流畅奠定了基础.

articles.title: VibeAvatar: Aligning Phonetic Kinematics and Human Aesthetics for High-Fidelity Talking Avatar Synthesis
articles.content: Multi-modal talking avatar synthesis aims to generate realistic talking videos from a reference portrait and speech. Despite rapid progress in diffusion-based methods, existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve accurate lip articulation, human-preferred motion aesthetics, and efficient inference. We observe that phonetic accuracy and motion aesthetics arise from fundamentally different sources and should be addressed at complementary stages rather than learned implicitly by a single generator. Based on this insight, we propose VibeAvatar, which disentangles these two objectives through a Phonetic Kinematics Adapter (PKA) that converts recognition-oriented speech features into phonetic-kinematic conditions at the conditioning stage, and an Aesthetic Motion Policy (AMP) that optimizes a flow-consistent stochastic sampling policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the post-training stage. With a lightweight flow-based motion generator operating in a compact 1D warp-based latent motion space, VibeAvatar achieves state-of-the-art results in articulation, aesthetics, and efficiency on both objective metrics and user studies, while generating a 10-second 512px video in under 10 seconds with only $\sim$3GB VRAM.

articles.title_zh: VibeAvatar: 调和语音动词学和人文美学用于高真性说话神通合成
articles.content_zh: 多模式对话阿凡达合成旨在从参考肖像和演讲中产生现实的谈话视频. 尽管在传播方法方面取得了迅速进展,但现有方法仍然难以共同实现准确的唇语表达、人类偏爱的运动美学和高效的推论。 我们认为,口语准确性和运动美学来源根本不同,应在补充阶段处理,而不是由单一生成者间接学习。 基于这种洞察力,我们提出VibeAvatar,它通过一个Phonetic Kinematics Adapter(PKA)将面向识别的语音特征转换成在调理阶段的语音条件,通过在培训后阶段通过Group相对政策优化(GRPO)优化流调性抽样政策,将这两个目标分开. 随着轻量级流动发生器在紧凑的1D曲速型潜伏运动空间中运行,VibeAvatar在表达,美学,以及客观度量和用户研究上都取得了最先进的成果,同时在10秒内生成10秒512px视频,只有$\sim$3GB VRAM.

articles.title: FIVE-VLA: Fast and EffectIVE Autonomous Driving with Recurrent Action Memory
articles.content: State-of-the-art vision-language-action models (VLA) for autonomous driving face critical limitations: excessive parameter counts, inefficient high-resolution image processing, and lack of temporal memory. We introduce Fast and EffectIVE VLA (FIVE-VLA) to address these through two key contributions. First, we employ an efficient vision encoder that processes high-resolution ($448 \times 896$) images while generating only 98 tokens, over $5\times$ fewer than existing approaches, and bypass text generation entirely for single-pass trajectory prediction. Second, we propose Recurrent Action Memory (RAM), a lightweight module that conditions action prediction on previous action tokens, providing temporal context critical for manoeuvres such as overtaking and emergency braking. With only 641M parameters, FIVE-VLA completes $\sim$10% more routes without traffic rule infractions than the previous state-of-the-art VLA on the challenging Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark. Non-reactive open-loop simulation on the large-scale real-world NVIDIA Physical AI AV dataset shows 10.2% and 7.7% lower collision-violation rates than SimLingo in single- and four-view settings, respectively. Additionally, FIVE-VLA runs at $\sim$30 fps on an A100 and $\sim$4 fps on a T4 GPU (proxy to an edge device), representing an 8-30$\times$ speedup over previous methods.

articles.title_zh: Five-VLA:具有经常性行动记忆的快速和有效自主驾驶
articles.content_zh: 自主驱动的先进视觉语言动作模型(VLA)面临关键限制:参数计数过多,高分辨率图像处理效率低下,以及缺乏时间记忆. 我们通过两项关键贡献,引入了 " 快速和有效VLA " (Five-VLA)来解决这些问题。 首先,我们使用一个高效的视觉编码器,处理高分辨率(448\time 896美元)图像,而只生成98个信使,比现有方法少5美元以上,并绕过文本生成,完全用于单路轨道预测。 第二,我们提出经常性行动记忆(RAM),这是一个轻量级模块,将动作预测的条件设于之前的动作符号上,提供超时和紧急制动等动作的关键时间背景. 仅使用641M参数,FVE-VLA在不违反交通规则的情况下完成10%的路线,比之前在挑战性Beach2Drive闭路驾驶基准上的VLA最先进. 在大型现实世界NVIDIA物理AI AV数据集上的非反应性开放性模拟显示,单景和四景环境下的碰撞率分别比SimLingo低10.2%和7.7%. 此外,FVE-VLA在A100上以$\sim$30 fps运行,在T4 GPU上以$\sim$4 fps运行(代用到边缘设备),比以前的方法快8-30美元\times.

articles.title: PULSE: Unlocking Practical Image Compression on Single-Thread CPU
articles.content: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, existing methods remain computationally expensive on resource-constrained hardware, particularly CPUs. We introduce PULSE, a practical codec that enables (1) low-latency decoding on diverse hardware platforms with an ultra-low-complexity 5.2 kMAC/pixel neural receiver, and (2) efficient bit-exact entropy coding with an integer linear CDF predictor and a meta prior. To recover compression performance under this tight budget, we introduce an agentic evolution process guided by heuristic probes that iteratively improves the architecture through human-LLM collaboration. PULSE decodes a 1080p image in 126 ms on a single CPU thread while achieving compression performance comparable to HM. After perceptual optimization, PULSE competes with larger perceptual codecs like MS-ILLM. Codes are at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

articles.title_zh: PULSE:解锁单轨CPU上的实用图像压缩
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在学习到的图像压缩方面取得了进展,但现有方法在资源限制的硬件,特别是CPU上仍然在计算上昂贵. 我们引入了PULSE这个实用的编码器,它使(1)在各种硬件平台上用超低复杂度的5.2 kMAC/像素神经接收器进行低纬度解码,以及(2)用整数线性CDF预测器和元前的高效位-精确 en编码. 为了在如此紧凑的预算下恢复压缩性能,我们引入了一种由热力探测器引导的代理进化过程,通过人与LLM合作,迭代地改进架构. PULSE在单CPU线程上以126ms的图像解码1080p,同时实现与HM类似的压缩性能. 在感知优化后,PULSE与MS-ILLM等更大的感知解码器竞争. 代码见https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

articles.title: On-the-Fly Homographies Calibration for Multi-Camera Tracking
articles.content: Precise multi-camera tracking traditionally relies on rigorous 3D site calibration, yet this requirement is often operationally impossible in large-scale deployments. Privacy regulations frequently prohibit recording video for offline calibration; limited bandwidth precludes synchronizing high-resolution streams from hundreds of cameras; and covering immense physical sites with calibration targets is logistically infeasible. We present a multi-camera homography calibration system designed to overcome these barriers through "on-the-fly" geometric refinement. Starting from coarse manual homographies, we introduce a centroid-based projection optimization (PO) that continuously aligns the ground-plane geometry using live detection streams. Because PO operates asynchronously on already-transmitted, lightweight metadata, it adds zero computational latency to the real-time tracker. This allows the system to adapt automatically to camera movements or environmental changes without human intervention. This optimized geometry feeds a multi-camera bird's-eye-view (BEV) tracker that fuses detections and unifies trajectories across zones. Crucially, by operating strictly on live anonymous metadata, our solution ensures a privacy-safe, zero-overhead, and resilient tracking pipeline that maintains global consistency in dynamic environments where static, recorded-video calibration is impossible.
